review.notes: Every extracted PDF page line was compared against the OCR markdown with normalization and fuzzy matching; code-fence balance and markdown headings were checked, and HTML table values were spot-checked against the PDF text layer (EvalMuse table). Rendered physical page 4 (footnotes) plus 300 dpi crops of the five changed lines on pages 12, 14, 19 and 23 were visually inspected. OCR silently corrected five of the print's own misspellings ('addtion', 'dateset', 'repetting', 'excells', 'responsed'), and dropped the two URL footnote bodies on page 4 while keeping their markers. Figure-internal caption examples and chart labels (pages 5, 7, 8, 15, 20, 22, 23) are inside embedded figures and were not transcribed as body text.
